svg.aria-label: A smaller company building sits on a shrinking coin stack, marked by a dashed outline and yellow arrow showing the drop, topped by a cheerful robot, beside a chart whose line falls off the edge, labeled Stock Falls. Across a dashed divider, a worker carries an envelope away from a darker, empty building, leaving behind an empty chair that now holds a small glowing box, labeled Jobs Cut.
